graph.dependencyRule: Each node above layer 0 references offsets 0 through 9 of the previous layer, wrapping within its 25 nodes.

arithmetic.rule: Start at ((id + 1) * seedMultiplier) % modulus. For each dependency in order, value = (value * multiplier + dependencyValue * (index + 1) + (id + 1) * saltMultiplier) % modulus.
